Mod.Name: 60/30 FPS Animations for New Threat 2.0
Mod.Description: Provide BATTLE and FIELD mode compatibility of New Threat 2.0 (works also for New Threat 2.0 Combat Only) mod with 60 FPS Gameplay mod. Both "Full 30 FPS" and "Full 60 FPS" of 60 FPS Gameplay mod are available (Can be changed in the mod config options)
